### Gold STTM Summary

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| **Surrogate Key** | `pk_gold_sales_metrics_id` — auto-increment primary key for the Gold fact table |
| **Source Tables** | `sales_data_silver`, `products_silver`, `stores_silver` |
| **Join 1** | `sales_data_silver.product_id` = `products_silver.product_sk` (LEFT JOIN) |
| **Join 2** | `sales_data_silver.store_id` = `stores_silver.store_sk` (LEFT JOIN) |
| **Aggregation Grain** | `transaction_date`, `store_name`, `product_name`, `category`, `region`, `city`, `state`, `customer_segment`, `payment_method` |
| **KPIs / Metrics** | |
| • `total_revenue` | `SUM(total_amount)` |
| • `total_quantity_sold` | `SUM(quantity)` |
| • `avg_transaction_value` | `AVG(total_amount)` |
| • `discount_amount` | `SUM((standard_price - unit_price) × quantity)` — derived from joined `standard_price` |
| • `revenue_share_pct` | `total_revenue / SUM(total_revenue) OVER ()` — percentage of overall revenue |
| **Business Rules** | Hierarchy rollup (region → state → city); category-level revenue breakdown; store performance ranking by revenue |
| **Metadata** | `_load_timestamp` — ETL run timestamp |

The Gold layer consolidates the three Silver tables into a single analytics-ready fact table with denormalized dimensions, pre-computed KPIs, and business-rule-driven aggregations.
